/** Node-only metadata bridge. No environment/credential discovery or public route. */
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { HISTORY_CUSTODY_AUTHORITY_SQL } from "./history-custody-authority-sql.js";
import { compatibleCustodySourceAuthority } from "./delivery-source-authority-sql.js";
import {
  HISTORY_CURRENT_METADATA_PROTOCOL,
  HISTORY_CUSTODY_RECORD_IDS,
  HISTORY_CUSTODY_OWNER_PAGE,
  HISTORY_CUSTODY_PAGE_BYTES,
  HISTORY_CUSTODY_LOOKUP_BYTES,
  type HistoryCustodyAuthority,
  type HistoryCustodyLookupInput,
  type HistoryCustodySnapshot,
  type HistoryCustodySourcePort,
  type HistoryCustodyRow,
  type HistoryCustodyOwner,
  type HistoryCustodyOwnerHead,
  type HistoryCustodyRevalidateInput,
  type HistoryCustodyRevalidation,
} from "./history-custody-contract.js";

export interface HistoryCustodyClient {
  /** Must come from the actual sticky PG client's connection parameters. */
  readonly connectionParameters: { host: string; database: string };
  readonly pipeline?: boolean;
  connect(): Promise<void>;
  query(
    text: string,
    values?: unknown[],
  ): Promise<{ rows: Record<string, unknown>[] }>;
  end(): Promise<void>;
}
export interface HistoryCustodyNodeDeps {
  /** Explicit approved readonly connection; never an owner/SET ROLE substitute. */
  makeClient(): HistoryCustodyClient;
  hostname: string;
}
export class HistoryCustodySourceError extends Error {
  constructor(readonly code: "not_ready" | "capacity" | "changed" | "invalid") {
    super("History source metadata is unavailable");
    this.name = "HistoryCustodySourceError";
  }
}
function fail(code: HistoryCustodySourceError["code"] = "not_ready"): never {
  throw new HistoryCustodySourceError(code);
}
const object = (v: unknown): v is Record<string, unknown> =>
  v !== null && typeof v === "object" && !Array.isArray(v);
const hash = (v: unknown): v is string =>
  typeof v === "string" && /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/u.test(v);
const encoder = new TextEncoder();
const bytes = (v: unknown) => encoder.encode(JSON.stringify(v)).byteLength;
const label = (v: unknown): v is string =>
  typeof v === "string" &&
  encoder.encode(v).byteLength >= 1 &&
  encoder.encode(v).byteLength <= 512 &&
  !/[\u0000-\u001f\u007f]/u.test(v) &&
  new TextDecoder("utf-8", { fatal: true, ignoreBOM: true }).decode(
    encoder.encode(v),
  ) === v;
const decimal = (v: unknown, positive = false): v is string =>
  typeof v === "string" &&
  /^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$/u.test(v) &&
  v.length <= 19 &&
  BigInt(v) <= 9223372036854775807n &&
  (!positive || BigInt(v) > 0n);
function compare(a: string, b: string) {
  const x = encoder.encode(a),
    y = encoder.encode(b);
  for (let n = 0; n < Math.min(x.length, y.length); n++)
    if (x[n] !== y[n]) return x[n]! - y[n]!;
  return x.length - y.length;
}
const digest = (s: string) =>
  createHash("sha256").update(s, "utf8").digest("hex");
function labels(v: readonly string[]) {
  if (
    !Array.isArray(v) ||
    v.some((x) => !label(x)) ||
    new Set(v).size !== v.length
  )
    fail("invalid");
  return [...v].sort(compare);
}
function config(d: HistoryCustodyNodeDeps) {
  if (!/^[-a-z0-9.]{1,253}$/u.test(d.hostname)) fail("invalid");
}
async function deadline<T>(
  promise: Promise<T>,
  ms: number,
  signal?: AbortSignal,
  abort?: () => void,
): Promise<T> {
  if (signal?.aborted || ms <= 0) {
    abort?.();
    fail();
  }
  return await new Promise<T>((resolve, reject) => {
    let settled = false;
    const finish = (f: () => void) => {
      if (settled) return;
      settled = true;
      clearTimeout(timer);
      signal?.removeEventListener("abort", stopped);
      f();
    };
    const stopped = () =>
      finish(() => {
        abort?.();
        reject(new HistoryCustodySourceError("not_ready"));
      });
    const timer = setTimeout(stopped, ms);
    signal?.addEventListener("abort", stopped, { once: true });
    promise.then(
      (v) => finish(() => resolve(v)),
      (e) => finish(() => reject(e)),
    );
    if (signal?.aborted) stopped();
  });
}
type Query = (
  text: string,
  values?: unknown[],
) => Promise<{ rows: Record<string, unknown>[] }>;
async function transaction<T>(
  d: HistoryCustodyNodeDeps,
  work: (q: Query) => Promise<T>,
  signal?: AbortSignal,
): Promise<T> {
  config(d);
  if (signal?.aborted) fail();
  let client: HistoryCustodyClient;
  try {
    client = d.makeClient();
  } catch {
    fail();
  }
  let beginAttempted = false,
    closed: Promise<void> | undefined;
  const close = () => {
    closed ??= Promise.resolve()
      .then(() => client.end())
      .catch(() => undefined);
  };
  const started = Date.now();
  const q: Query = (text, values) =>
    deadline(
      client.query(text, values),
      Math.min(5500, 30_000 - (Date.now() - started)),
      signal,
      close,
    );
  try {
    if (client.pipeline || client.connectionParameters.host !== d.hostname)
      fail("invalid");
    await deadline(client.connect(), 5000, signal, close);
    beginAttempted = true;
    await q("BEGIN ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY");
    await q(
      "SET LOCAL statement_timeout='5000ms'; SET LOCAL lock_timeout='5000ms'; SET LOCAL idle_in_transaction_session_timeout='30000ms'; SET LOCAL plan_cache_mode='force_custom_plan'; SET LOCAL TIME ZONE 'UTC'",
    );
    const stamp = async () => {
      const result = await q(
        "SELECT pg_backend_pid()::text AS pid, pg_current_snapshot()::text AS snapshot",
      );
      const r = result.rows[0];
      if (
        result.rows.length !== 1 ||
        !r ||
        !decimal(r.pid, true) ||
        typeof r.snapshot !== "string" ||
        !/^[0-9]+:[0-9]+:([0-9]+(,[0-9]+)*)?$/u.test(r.snapshot)
      )
        fail();
      return JSON.stringify([r.pid, r.snapshot]);
    };
    const before = await stamp();
    const value = await work(q);
    if ((await stamp()) !== before) fail("changed");
    await q("COMMIT");
    beginAttempted = false;
    return value;
  } catch (e) {
    if (e instanceof HistoryCustodySourceError) throw e;
    throw new HistoryCustodySourceError(
      object(e) && e.code === "54000" ? "capacity" : "not_ready",
    );
  } finally {
    if (beginAttempted && !closed) {
      try {
        await deadline(client.query("ROLLBACK"), 1500, undefined, close);
      } catch {
        /* close the owned session */
      }
    }
    close();
    await deadline(closed!, 1500).catch(() => undefined);
  }
}
function validateAuthority(
  row: Record<string, unknown>,
): HistoryCustodyAuthority {
  const a = row.descriptor;
  if (
    !object(a) ||
    !compatibleCustodySourceAuthority(a) ||
    a.protocol !== "history-publication-source-v1" ||
    a.writableSource !== false ||
    !hash(row.source_authority_sha256) ||
    !hash(row.provider_identity_sha256) ||
    !object(row.provider_identity)
  )
    fail();
  const f = a.publicationFunction,
    fs = a.functions,
    role = a.connectionRole;
  if (
    !object(f) ||
    !object(fs) ||
    !object(fs.guard_delivery_cutover_v1) ||
    !object(role) ||
    f.owner !== fs.guard_delivery_cutover_v1.owner ||
    f.volatility !== "s" ||
    f.definer !== true ||
    f.strict !== false ||
    f.parallel !== "u" ||
    f.leakproof !== false ||
    f.set !== false ||
    f.result !== "jsonb" ||
    f.args !== "text, text, text, text, jsonb, jsonb" ||
    f.language !== "plpgsql" ||
    f.callable !== true ||
    !hash(f.sha256) ||
    !Array.isArray(f.config) ||
    f.config.length !== 1 ||
    typeof f.config[0] !== "string" ||
    f.config[0].replaceAll(" ", "") !==
      "search_path=pg_catalog,sessions,pg_temp" ||
    !Array.isArray(f.acl) ||
    !f.acl.length ||
    !f.acl.every(
      (x) =>
        object(x) &&
        x.privilege === "EXECUTE" &&
        x.grantee !== "0" &&
        (x.role === f.owner ||
          ((x.role === role.sessionUser || x.role === role.currentUser) &&
            x.grantable === false)),
    )
  )
    fail();
  if (!Array.isArray(a.publicationIndexes) || a.publicationIndexes.length !== 2)
    fail();
  for (const [name, table, columns, predicate] of [
    [
      "delivery_records_record_idx",
      "sessions.delivery_records",
      "org_id,workspace_id,record_id",
      null,
    ],
    [
      "convergence_events_delivery_record_idx",
      "sessions.convergence_events",
      "org_id,workspace_id,delivery_record_id",
      "delivery_record_idISNOTNULL",
    ],
  ] as const) {
    const i = a.publicationIndexes.find((x) => object(x) && x.name === name);
    if (
      !object(i) ||
      i.table !== table ||
      i.method !== "btree" ||
      i.valid !== true ||
      i.ready !== true ||
      i.live !== true ||
      i.unique !== false ||
      i.keyCount !== 3 ||
      i.columnCount !== 3 ||
      i.expressions !== null ||
      typeof i.definition !== "string" ||
      (predicate === null
        ? i.predicate !== null
        : typeof i.predicate !== "string" ||
          i.predicate.replace(/[()\s]/gu, "") !== predicate) ||
      !Array.isArray(i.keys) ||
      i.keys.map((x) => (object(x) ? x.name : "")).join(",") !== columns ||
      !i.keys.every(
        (x) =>
          object(x) && x.columnCollation === x.indexCollation && x.option === 0,
      )
    )
      fail();
  }
  const p = row.provider_identity;
  if (
    p.protocol !== "history-source-provider-v1" ||
    p.hostname !== a.hostname ||
    p.database !== a.database ||
    p.databaseOid !== a.databaseOid ||
    p.serverVersion !== a.serverVersion ||
    !decimal(p.databaseOid, true) ||
    !decimal(p.catalogSequenceOid, true) ||
    !decimal(p.projectionSequenceOid, true)
  )
    fail();
  return {
    sourceAuthoritySha256: row.source_authority_sha256,
    providerIdentitySha256: row.provider_identity_sha256,
    providerIdentity:
      p as unknown as HistoryCustodyAuthority["providerIdentity"],
    descriptor: a,
  };
}
async function authority(q: Query, hostname: string) {
  const r = await q(HISTORY_CUSTODY_AUTHORITY_SQL, [hostname]);
  if (r.rows.length !== 1) fail();
  return validateAuthority(r.rows[0]!);
}
export async function captureHistoryCustodyAuthority(
  d: HistoryCustodyNodeDeps,
  signal?: AbortSignal,
) {
  return await transaction(d, (q) => authority(q, d.hostname), signal);
}
function expected(
  a: HistoryCustodyAuthority,
  input: {
    expectedSourceAuthoritySha256: string;
    expectedProviderIdentitySha256: string;
    controlEpoch: string;
  },
) {
  if (
    !hash(input.expectedSourceAuthoritySha256) ||
    !hash(input.expectedProviderIdentitySha256) ||
    !hash(input.controlEpoch)
  )
    fail("invalid");
  if (
    a.sourceAuthoritySha256 !== input.expectedSourceAuthoritySha256 ||
    a.providerIdentitySha256 !== input.expectedProviderIdentitySha256
  )
    fail("changed");
}
function row(v: unknown): HistoryCustodyRow {
  if (
    !object(v) ||
    Object.keys(v).sort().join(",") !==
      "catalogAcceptedSeq,currentFenced,digest,kind,operation,originId,projectedExists,projectionAcceptedSeq,receivedAt,recordId,revision,revisionId,sessionId,source,userId" ||
    ![v.originId, v.recordId, v.userId, v.revisionId, v.kind, v.source].every(
      label,
    ) ||
    !decimal(v.revision, true) ||
    !hash(v.digest) ||
    !["upsert", "delete"].includes(String(v.operation)) ||
    !(v.sessionId === null || label(v.sessionId)) ||
    typeof v.receivedAt !== "string" ||
    v.receivedAt.length > 128 ||
    !Number.isFinite(Date.parse(v.receivedAt)) ||
    !(v.catalogAcceptedSeq === null || decimal(v.catalogAcceptedSeq)) ||
    !(v.projectionAcceptedSeq === null || decimal(v.projectionAcceptedSeq)) ||
    typeof v.projectedExists !== "boolean" ||
    typeof v.currentFenced !== "boolean"
  )
    fail();
  return v as unknown as HistoryCustodyRow;
}
function owner(
  v: unknown,
  full: boolean,
  epoch: string,
): HistoryCustodyOwnerHead | HistoryCustodyOwner {
  if (
    !object(v) ||
    !label(v.userId) ||
    v.controlEpoch !== epoch ||
    !decimal(v.version) ||
    typeof v.pending !== "boolean" ||
    !decimal(v.privacyVersion) ||
    BigInt(v.privacyVersion) > BigInt(v.version) ||
    Object.keys(v).sort().join(",") !==
      (full
        ? "controlEpoch,pending,pendingControl,privacy,privacyVersion,userId,version"
        : "controlEpoch,pending,pendingControl,privacyVersion,userId,version")
  )
    fail();
  if (v.pending) {
    if (
      !decimal(v.version, true) ||
      BigInt(v.privacyVersion) !== BigInt(v.version) - 1n
    )
      fail();
    const c = v.pendingControl;
    if (
      !object(c) ||
      Object.keys(c).sort().join(",") !== "digest,epoch,kind,version" ||
      c.epoch !== epoch ||
      c.version !== v.version ||
      !decimal(c.version, true) ||
      !hash(c.digest) ||
      !["selection", "reset"].includes(String(c.kind))
    )
      fail();
  } else if (v.pendingControl !== null || v.privacyVersion !== v.version)
    fail();
  if (full) {
    const p = v.privacy;
    if (p === null) {
      if (v.version === "0") fail();
    } else {
      if (
        !object(p) ||
        Object.keys(p).sort().join(",") !== "complete,deletions,resets" ||
        !(v.version === "0" || (v.version === "1" && v.pending)) ||
        p.complete !== true ||
        !Array.isArray(p.deletions) ||
        !Array.isArray(p.resets) ||
        p.deletions.length + p.resets.length > 5000 ||
        bytes(p) > 512 * 1024 ||
        !p.deletions.every(
          (x) =>
            object(x) &&
            Object.keys(x).sort().join(",") === "origin_id,session_id,source" &&
            [x.origin_id, x.source, x.session_id].every(label),
        ) ||
        !p.resets.every(
          (x) =>
            object(x) &&
            Object.keys(x).sort().join(",") === "deleted,request_id" &&
            label(x.request_id) &&
            decimal(x.deleted),
        )
      )
        fail();
    }
  } else if ("privacy" in v) fail();
  return v as unknown as HistoryCustodyOwner;
}
type Mode = "records" | "owners" | "heads";
async function page(
  q: Query,
  input: { orgId: string; workspaceId: string; controlEpoch: string },
  mode: Mode,
  ids: string[],
  owners: string[],
) {
  const r = await q(
    `WITH packet AS MATERIALIZED(
    SELECT sessions.read_history_custody_page_v1($1,$2,$3,$4,$5::jsonb,$6::jsonb) v
  ) SELECT v AS packet,
    encode(sha256(convert_to((v->'page')::text,'UTF8')),'hex') AS computed_sha256,
    octet_length((v->'page')::text) AS computed_bytes,
    octet_length(v::text) AS computed_packet_bytes FROM packet`,
    [
      input.orgId,
      input.workspaceId,
      input.controlEpoch,
      mode,
      JSON.stringify(ids),
      JSON.stringify(owners),
    ],
  );
  if (r.rows.length !== 1) fail();
  const value = r.rows[0]!,
    packet = value.packet;
  if (
    !object(packet) ||
    !object(packet.page) ||
    !hash(packet.pageSha256) ||
    packet.pageSha256 !== value.computed_sha256 ||
    packet.pageBytes !== value.computed_bytes ||
    typeof packet.pageBytes !== "number" ||
    packet.pageBytes < 1 ||
    packet.pageBytes > HISTORY_CUSTODY_PAGE_BYTES ||
    typeof value.computed_packet_bytes !== "number" ||
    value.computed_packet_bytes < packet.pageBytes ||
    value.computed_packet_bytes > HISTORY_CUSTODY_PAGE_BYTES
  )
    fail();
  const p = packet.page;
  if (
    p.protocol !== "history-current-metadata-page-v1" ||
    p.complete !== true ||
    p.mode !== mode ||
    p.orgId !== input.orgId ||
    p.workspaceId !== input.workspaceId ||
    p.controlEpoch !== input.controlEpoch
  )
    fail("changed");
  if (mode === "records") {
    if (
      JSON.stringify(p.requestedRecordIds) !== JSON.stringify(ids) ||
      !Array.isArray(p.rows) ||
      p.rows.length !== p.rowCount ||
      p.rows.length > 10_000
    )
      fail();
    const recordRows = p.rows.map(row);
    p.rows = recordRows;
    if (
      !recordRows.every((x) => ids.includes(x.recordId)) ||
      new Set(recordRows.map((x) => JSON.stringify([x.recordId, x.originId])))
        .size !== recordRows.length
    )
      fail();
  } else {
    if (
      JSON.stringify(p.requestedOwners) !== JSON.stringify(owners) ||
      !Array.isArray(p.owners) ||
      p.owners.length !== owners.length ||
      p.ownerCount !== owners.length
    )
      fail();
    p.owners = p.owners.map((x) =>
      owner(x, mode === "owners", input.controlEpoch),
    );
    if (
      new Set((p.owners as HistoryCustodyOwnerHead[]).map((x) => x.userId))
        .size !== owners.length ||
      !(p.owners as HistoryCustodyOwnerHead[]).every((x) =>
        owners.includes(x.userId),
      )
    )
      fail();
  }
  return {
    value: p,
    hash: packet.pageSha256,
    size: value.computed_packet_bytes,
  };
}
function validInput(input: {
  orgId: string;
  workspaceId: string;
  expectedSourceAuthoritySha256: string;
  expectedProviderIdentitySha256: string;
  controlEpoch: string;
}) {
  if (
    !label(input.orgId) ||
    (input.workspaceId !== "" && !label(input.workspaceId)) ||
    !hash(input.expectedSourceAuthoritySha256) ||
    !hash(input.expectedProviderIdentitySha256) ||
    !hash(input.controlEpoch)
  )
    fail("invalid");
}
export function createHistoryCustodySource(
  d: HistoryCustodyNodeDeps,
): HistoryCustodySourcePort {
  return {
    async snapshot(
      input: HistoryCustodyLookupInput,
      signal?: AbortSignal,
    ): Promise<HistoryCustodySnapshot> {
      validInput(input);
      const ids = labels(input.recordIds),
        prior = labels(input.priorOwners);
      if (
        ids.length < 1 ||
        ids.length > HISTORY_CUSTODY_RECORD_IDS ||
        bytes([ids, prior]) > HISTORY_CUSTODY_LOOKUP_BYTES
      )
        fail("capacity");
      return await transaction(
        d,
        async (q) => {
          const a = await authority(q, d.hostname);
          expected(a, input);
          let chain = "0".repeat(64),
            size = 0,
            recordPages = 0,
            ownerPages = 0;
          const rows: HistoryCustodyRow[] = [],
            allOwners = new Set(prior),
            owners: HistoryCustodyOwner[] = [];
          const received = (p: { hash: string; size: number }) => {
            size += p.size;
            if (size > HISTORY_CUSTODY_LOOKUP_BYTES) fail("capacity");
            chain = digest(chain + "\n" + p.hash);
          };
          const records = async (keys: string[]): Promise<void> => {
            await q("SAVEPOINT history_custody_page");
            let p: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof page>>;
            try {
              p = await page(q, input, "records", keys, []);
            } catch (e) {
              await q("ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT history_custody_page");
              await q("RELEASE SAVEPOINT history_custody_page");
              if (object(e) && e.code === "54000" && keys.length > 1) {
                const n = Math.floor(keys.length / 2);
                await records(keys.slice(0, n));
                await records(keys.slice(n));
                return;
              }
              throw e;
            }
            await q("RELEASE SAVEPOINT history_custody_page");
            received(p);
            recordPages++;
            for (const r of p.value.rows as HistoryCustodyRow[]) {
              rows.push(r);
              allOwners.add(r.userId);
            }
          };
          await records(ids);
          const users = [...allOwners].sort(compare);
          for (let n = 0; n < users.length; n += HISTORY_CUSTODY_OWNER_PAGE) {
            const p = await page(
              q,
              input,
              "owners",
              [],
              users.slice(n, n + HISTORY_CUSTODY_OWNER_PAGE),
            );
            received(p);
            ownerPages++;
            owners.push(...(p.value.owners as HistoryCustodyOwner[]));
          }
          const after = await authority(q, d.hostname);
          expected(after, input);
          rows.sort(
            (x, y) =>
              compare(x.recordId, y.recordId) ||
              compare(x.originId, y.originId),
          );
          const terminal = {
            rowCount: rows.length,
            ownerCount: owners.length,
            recordPages,
            ownerPages,
            chainSha256: chain,
          };
          const result: HistoryCustodySnapshot = {
            protocol: HISTORY_CURRENT_METADATA_PROTOCOL,
            orgId: input.orgId,
            workspaceId: input.workspaceId,
            sourceAuthoritySha256: a.sourceAuthoritySha256,
            providerIdentitySha256: a.providerIdentitySha256,
            controlEpoch: input.controlEpoch,
            complete: true,
            requestedRecordIds: ids,
            rows,
            owners,
            terminal,
            lookupSha256: digest(
              JSON.stringify([
                "history-current-metadata-snapshot-v1",
                a.sourceAuthoritySha256,
                a.providerIdentitySha256,
                input.orgId,
                input.workspaceId,
                input.controlEpoch,
                ids,
                terminal,
              ]),
            ),
          };
          if (bytes(result) > HISTORY_CUSTODY_LOOKUP_BYTES) fail("capacity");
          return result;
        },
        signal,
      );
    },
    async revalidate(
      input: HistoryCustodyRevalidateInput,
      signal?: AbortSignal,
    ): Promise<HistoryCustodyRevalidation> {
      validInput(input);
      const users = labels(input.owners);
      if (bytes(users) > HISTORY_CUSTODY_LOOKUP_BYTES) fail("capacity");
      return await transaction(
        d,
        async (q) => {
          const a = await authority(q, d.hostname);
          expected(a, input);
          const owners: HistoryCustodyOwnerHead[] = [];
          let chain = "0".repeat(64),
            size = 0;
          for (let n = 0; n < Math.max(1, users.length); n += 500) {
            const p = await page(
              q,
              input,
              "heads",
              [],
              users.slice(n, n + 500),
            );
            size += p.size;
            if (size > HISTORY_CUSTODY_LOOKUP_BYTES) fail("capacity");
            chain = digest(chain + "\n" + p.hash);
            owners.push(...(p.value.owners as HistoryCustodyOwnerHead[]));
          }
          expected(await authority(q, d.hostname), input);
          return {
            protocol: HISTORY_CURRENT_METADATA_PROTOCOL,
            sourceAuthoritySha256: a.sourceAuthoritySha256,
            providerIdentitySha256: a.providerIdentitySha256,
            controlEpoch: input.controlEpoch,
            complete: true,
            owners,
            lookupSha256: digest(
              JSON.stringify([
                "history-current-metadata-revalidate-v1",
                a.sourceAuthoritySha256,
                a.providerIdentitySha256,
                input.orgId,
                input.workspaceId,
                input.controlEpoch,
                users,
                chain,
              ]),
            ),
          };
        },
        signal,
      );
    },
  };
}
